title: FZ-R1.1 Local remote-link controls
description: Local v1 Bearer/WS ticket boundary; not remote browser HTTP and not Worker wire frames. Secret material never enters any view or event.

serverOrigin.description: HTTPS origin only; HTTP 127.0.0.1/localhost requires Worker development mode. No userinfo/path/query/fragment. P2 must URL-parse/validate host and normalize scheme/host/default port/trailing root slash; this pattern does not replace URL parsing.

RemoteLinkUnpairedView.description: Local binding absent. Optional origin may remain as non-secret preference; lastErrorCode may report unconfirmed best-effort server revocation. Existing remote conversations remain remote and locally read-only.

serverOrigin.description: HTTPS origin only; HTTP 127.0.0.1/localhost requires Worker development mode. No userinfo/path/query/fragment. P2 must URL-parse/validate host and normalize scheme/host/default port/trailing root slash; this pattern does not replace URL parsing.

RemoteLinkPairingView.description: A server challenge has been obtained. Short code only, never device secret. Expiry/cancel clears candidate credentials and returns unpaired.

serverOrigin.description: HTTPS origin only; HTTP 127.0.0.1/localhost requires Worker development mode. No userinfo/path/query/fragment. P2 must URL-parse/validate host and normalize scheme/host/default port/trailing root slash; this pattern does not replace URL parsing.

lastConnectedAt.description: Last confirmed successful WSS connection; null means never connected. Do not invent a timestamp at pairing.

RemoteLinkPairedView.description: Local binding view; connectionStatus is transport only. Paired does not imply WSS connected or execution succeeded.

RemoteLinkRevokedView.description: Local binding view; connectionStatus is transport only. Revocation fences reconnect; it does not stop or rewrite execution state.

RemoteLinkFrozenView.description: Local binding view; connectionStatus is transport only. Frozen blocks command delivery pending reconciliation, even when WSS is online.

RemoteLinkPairingInput.description: Local authenticated pairing request. Worker creates/stores the device credential internally; client cannot supply or retrieve it. Changing server while already paired requires explicit unlink.
